name: csharp-best-practices
description: C# 14/.NET 10 baseline with conditional non-preview C# 15/.NET 11 best practices, plus dotnet CLI skills.

interface.shortDescription: C# 14/.NET 10 baseline, conditional non-preview C# 15, MTP testing, and dotnet CLI workflows.
interface.longDescription: A collection of C#/.NET skills covering modern C# 14 language features, conditional non-preview C# 15 features for .NET 11, performance tuning, dotnet CLI operations, project initialization, test conventions, Microsoft Testing Platform runner and CI patterns, API and MongoDB integration testing with Verify and Testcontainers, MongoDB driver patterns, Aspire resources, Playwright E2E testing, Microsoft Agent Framework, and file-based apps.
defaultPrompt: Review this C# code against modern C# 14 best practices or conditional C# 15 guidance
Write integration tests for this API using Verify snapshots
Configure Microsoft Testing Platform and run the tests for this .NET solution
capabilities: Write and review C# code with modern C# 14 idioms and conditional non-preview C# 15 features
Run dotnet CLI builds, tests, and publishes with structured output
Configure Microsoft Testing Platform runners, extensions, and CI reporting
Design MongoDB, API, and Playwright E2E tests with Testcontainers and Verify
